description: Shared UI components: create SessionSelector.jsx and PreviousSessionPanel.jsx, then wire both into StudentReportDrawer.jsx. Depends on FEAT-001 (prevSessionCache.js must already exist).
steps:
Create src/react/components/SessionSelector.jsx. Props: { studentId, currentSessionName, selectedSessionId, onSelect }. onSelect(id, name) where id is null for current session or a string session id for a past session, and name is the session name string. State: pastSessions (array, default []), loading (bool, default true). useEffect on [studentId]: call getSessionsWithData(studentId).then(sessions => { setPastSessions(sessions); setLoading(false); }).catch(() => setLoading(false)). Render: if loading return null. If !loading && pastSessions.length === 0 return

{currentSessionName}

. Otherwise return . Import getSessionsWithData from '../../data/prevSessionCache.js'. Import useState, useEffect from 'react'.

Create src/react/components/PreviousSessionPanel.jsx. Props: { studentId, sessionId, sessionName, onDownload }. onDownload receives the full fetched data object so the caller can build the xlsx. State: data (null), loading (true), error (null), activeTerm (null). useEffect on [studentId, sessionId]: setLoading(true); setError(null); fetchPrevSession(studentId, sessionId).then(d => { setData(d); const terms = [3,2,1].find(t => (d.gradesByTerm[t]?.length ?? 0) > 0) ?? null; setActiveTerm(terms); setLoading(false); }).catch(e => { setError(e.message); setLoading(false); }). If loading: return
Loading session data…
. If error: return
Could not load data: {error}
. Sub-components all defined in the same file (not exported): SessionSummaryCards({ data, subjects }), TermTabs({ data, activeTerm, setActiveTerm }), ScoreTable({ data, activeTerm, subjects }), AttendanceSummary({ data }), GrowthSnapshot({ studentId, sessionId, data }). Imports: fetchPrevSession from '../../data/prevSessionCache.js'; Data from '../../data/index.js'; gradeLabel, passMark from '../../utils.js'; useState, useEffect from 'react'. Never use window.* in JSX — use imported Data instead.

Sub-component detail for SessionSummaryCards: for each of [1,2,3] compute average of non-null scores (sum of (ca+exam) for rows with both non-null) / count. Session avg = average of the non-null term avgs. Render four <div className='stat-card'> inside <div className='session-summary-row'>.

Sub-component detail for TermTabs: only render tabs for terms where data.gradesByTerm[t]?.length > 0. Each tab: <button className={'tab-btn' + (activeTerm === t ? ' active' : '')} onClick={() => setActiveTerm(t)}>Term {t}</button>. Wrap in <div className='term-tabs'>.

Sub-component detail for ScoreTable: read activeTerm. scoresForTerm pure helper: for the given termNum, map data.gradesByTerm[termNum] rows to subject objects using Data.subjects() to get name/type/color/code. For T1/T2: columns Subject|Type|CA(40)|Exam(60)|Total|Grade|Pass/Fail. For T3: Subject|Type|CA(40)|Exam(60)|T3 Total|T2 Total|T1 Total|3-Term Avg|Grade|Pass/Fail. T3 grade and pass/fail are based on 3-term avg (not T3 total alone). Show '—' for null values. Render as <table> inside <div className='table-wrap'>.

Sub-component detail for AttendanceSummary: for each term 1/2/3, read data.attendanceByTerm[t] (object keyed by week label, value = days present integer). Compute pct = total days / (weeks * 5) * 100. Render three stat cards in a stat-row. Wrap in <div className='panel mt16'>.

Sub-component detail for GrowthSnapshot: call Data.artifacts() — filter where String(a.studentId ?? a.student_id) === String(studentId) AND String(a.sessionId ?? a.session_id) === String(sessionId) AND a.status === 'verified'. Call Data.commendations() — filter same studentId and sessionId. Call Data.promotionsFor(studentId) — find entry with matching sessionId. Show verified artifact count, commendation count, promotion outcome string. Wrap in <div className='growth-snapshot'>. If no data in any category show a muted 'No growth data recorded for this session.' message.

Modify src/react/components/StudentReportDrawer.jsx. Read the full file before editing. Changes: (1) Add useState to the React import line (currently only useEffect is imported). (2) Add imports: import SessionSelector from './SessionSelector.jsx'; import PreviousSessionPanel from './PreviousSessionPanel.jsx'; import { downloadXlsxMulti } from '../../utils.js'; (3) Inside the component body, before the existing locked-check, add: const [selectedSessionId, setSelectedSessionId] = useState(null); const [selectedSessionName, setSelectedSessionName] = useState(null); (4) Add useEffect to reset on studentId change: useEffect(() => { setSelectedSessionId(null); setSelectedSessionName(null); }, [studentId]); — add studentId to the dependency array of this new effect only; the existing openDrawer effect keeps its own deps. (5) Build handlePrevDownload function that, given fetched data, builds a 3-sheet xlsx via downloadXlsxMulti with filename `report_${s.name.replace(/\s+/g,'_')}_session_${(selectedSessionName||'').replace(/\s+/g,'_')}.xlsx` — one sheet per term using the same column logic as handleDownload. (6) In the JSX return of the non-locked branch, insert <SessionSelector studentId={studentId} currentSessionName={Data.session().name} selectedSessionId={selectedSessionId} onSelect={(id, name) => { setSelectedSessionId(id); setSelectedSessionName(name); }} /> as the very first child inside <div className='drawer-content'>. (7) Conditionally render: when selectedSessionId is non-null, render <PreviousSessionPanel studentId={studentId} sessionId={selectedSessionId} sessionName={selectedSessionName} onDownload={handlePrevDownload} /> in place of the existing score content (eyebrow through drawer-actions). When null, render the existing content unchanged. NOTE: the locked-branch return at the top of the component does NOT get a SessionSelector — keep it as-is.
acceptance_criteria:
SessionSelector renders a plain

when no past sessions have data for the student
SessionSelector renders a <select> with current session first when past sessions exist
PreviousSessionPanel shows loading state while fetch is in flight
PreviousSessionPanel shows error state on Supabase failure
PreviousSessionPanel shows SessionSummaryCards, TermTabs, ScoreTable, AttendanceSummary, GrowthSnapshot when data is loaded
T3 ScoreTable includes T2 Total, T1 Total, 3-Term Avg columns and bases grade/pass on the avg
StudentReportDrawer shows SessionSelector as first element in drawer-content
StudentReportDrawer renders PreviousSessionPanel when a past session is selected
StudentReportDrawer restores current-session content when user switches back to current
StudentReportDrawer resets selectedSessionId to null when studentId prop changes
npm run build exits 0 with no errors
findings: SessionSelector.jsx and PreviousSessionPanel.jsx created. StudentReportDrawer.jsx updated with useState, session selector state, reset-on-studentId effect, handlePrevDownload, SessionSelector as first child of drawer-content, and conditional PreviousSessionPanel rendering. Key note: Data.artifacts() and Data.commendations() cached objects do NOT include a sessionId field (the raw portfolio_artifacts table is fetched without session_id in data.js cache mapping), so GrowthSnapshot will always show 'No growth data' unless a future step adds session_id to the artifact cache. Data.promotionsFor() does include sessionId and will match correctly. Build exits 0. Dynamic import warnings are pre-existing and unrelated to this feature.
